releases.name: Below the Stone
releases.summary:
Below the Stone is a punishing pixel art roguelike about dwarves questing to reach the deepest depths. Each and every descent will lead to new adventures, where only the most determined players with many risked lives will be rewarded by the hidden world that lies Below the Stone.

Discover the lore of dwarves, the treasures they die for, and the secrets they rarely speak of. Within the stone below lies the adventure everyone seeks, but there's always a price. Often death.

releases.name: Unhistorical Warfare
releases.summary: Command 30+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Then deploy the anomalies: trolls, zombies, wizards, flying saucers and more!

releases.name: Super Plants
releases.summary: Super Plants is a short tower defense game about planting and growing super plants to defend against pests. Defeat enemies to unlock new plants and abilities, and grow the best defense.

releases.name: Time Well Spent: Tidy Up the Watch Shop
releases.summary: An elegant watch shop lies in chaos: over 1,000 watches are scattered across two floors. Read each dial, recognise its brand and its mechanism, and return every piece to its cabinet in this cozy tidy-up game, all while a narrated story about time and life unfolds.

releases.name: Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad
releases.summary: Sort 2500+ tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades.

releases.name: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks
releases.summary: Thousands of toy bricks are tipped across the floor. Sort every piece onto the right bookcase by shape, then into the right bin by color. Earn tokens, buy faster ways to tidy, from bigger pockets to sorting drones, and clear 13 rooms plus a Chaos Mode with all 114 shapes.

releases.name: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room
releases.summary: You have been chosen by Dr. Voss as heir to his scientific legacy. Explore his mysterious laboratory, solve ingenious puzzles rooted in Victorian science, and discover that the laboratory hides a secret far darker than Voss led you to believe.

releases.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
releases.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

releases.name: Sort Them Frogs
releases.summary: A greenhouse full of tiny frogs, and every one needs a place. Collect and sort 6,000 figures across 300 designs and 30 themes. Earn coins, upgrade your basket and turn a wonderfully messy shop into a collection you can admire.

releases.name: No Sleep Tonight
releases.summary: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

releases.name: Underbloom
releases.summary: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

releases.name: Shirt Happens!
releases.summary: Build a t-shirt brand with your friends online, or run the whole shop solo. Draw your own prints, then cut, sew, overlock and press every shirt by hand. Want a real factory? Bring up to 10. Do a bit of everything, or pick one station and master it.

releases.name: Unexpected Number Neighbour
releases.summary: An unknown number texts you at work. She’s cute, flirty, ginger… and her bust keeps growing for no clear reason. Reply carefully, don’t slack off too much, and unlock every ending in this short texting visual novel.

releases.name: Slightly Used Sorcery
releases.summary: Run a cozy magical pawnshop where you buy cursed junk, uncover ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, haggle with eccentric customers, and turn magical trash into profit.

releases.name: The Magician: Tidy Up the Magic Decks!
releases.summary: A cozy single-player simulation where you play as a magician bringing order to a magical mess. Search for scattered cards, sort them into their proper decks, and use your magic to tidy up. Don't forget to find your missing rabbits and doves along the way!

releases.name: Shadow at Noon
releases.summary: An interactive sound novel for honkaku mystery fans. No cutscenes, no spectacle: just text, art and sound, with every clue you need on the page. Amesaka, 2015. A rich family's eldest son lies dead at the foot of his stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. Every confession hides one lie.

releases.name: Scrap Cascade
releases.summary: Turn junk into a chain reaction in a compact factory strategy game. Connect machines, recycle waste and pick upgrade cards that change your plan. Grow through five contracts, adapt to new buyers and build a production line worth running again.

releases.name: Stash Mayhem
releases.summary: A fast-paced warehouse-sorting roguelike. Items keep arriving and customers keep ordering, so organize everything your way and deliver each order before their patience runs out. Carry too much at once and it all spills to the floor.

releases.name: Sploink
releases.summary: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

releases.name: Wreck and Repeat
releases.summary: An incremental crime sandbox. Outrun the cops and ramp up the citywide chaos. Drive anywhere in a procedural cyberpunk city where everything is destructible. Throw explosives, run over pedestrians, and spend your score on unlocks, upgrades, and bigger rides.

releases.name: Stevedore
releases.summary: No more job in the city. Managed to find one in the middle of nowhere. Stevedore. Crane worker. It feels off, but you need money. Stevedore is a short industrial horror game where you take a role of a crane worker. Lift containers, load ships and complete your contract. What could go wrong?

releases.name: Crusader Kings III: Silk & Silver
releases.summary:
Steer a powerful merchant company through the medieval era in Silk & Silver, a Major Expansion for Crusader Kings III.

Master the trade system by striking profitable deals that will bring prosperity to your house and to realms across the world. Win over local authorities as you expand your business interests, or seize power in a Republic by defeating your rivals as you turn your trading monopolies into political power.

releases.name: Block Garden
releases.summary: A 3D puzzle game about bringing jelly blocks together. Blocks of the same color stick when they touch, and once they're stuck they move as one piece. Push them around small islands with a cat until each color is joined up.

releases.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
releases.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the se-ries. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

releases.name: Bone Breaker
releases.summary: In this 2D platformer, through 4 different worlds. Face a gauntlet of 17 different boss fight. Beat them all and face your future. The golden crown awaits.

releases.name: PUT IT BACK
releases.summary: PUT IT BACK is a first-person horror game where restocking a supermarket turns into a nightmare. Pick up scattered products, return them to the shelves, and keep working as the lights begin to fail and something starts moving between the aisles.

releases.name: Sort Them Gnomes
releases.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game about turning a garden centre buried in over 2,000 gnomes into beautifully organised shelves. Relax, find every little character its perfect home and enjoy the satisfying calm of bringing order to the chaos - one more shelf at a time.

releases.name: Save Ruika! - Looping with a Losing Heroine
releases.summary: A short romance adventure where you loop again and again with a losing heroine to help her finally win. She cries, gets mad, loses again—and still refuses to give up. Does a brighter future await Ruika?

releases.name: Desktop Immortal (red prime)
releases.summary: An idle cultivation game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Meditate for Qi, break through realms by hand, hunt monsters for gear, and keep cultivating after you close the window.

releases.name: The Wheelerman
releases.summary: Sneak through a maze-like tire shop, find four golden display tires, and avoid the Wheelerman in this short comedy horror game.

releases.name: Borregada o Facto
releases.summary: Borregada or Facto is a quiz about current affairs, politics, history, and society. Answer questions, earn points, use cards and bonuses, and compete with your friends. Uncomfortable questions, real facts, and sources to check them yourself.

releases.name: Summer, Youth, and Baseball
releases.summary: A short incremental baseball game: hit the ball, collect cheers, reach the ending.

releases.name: Warm Worm: Together
releases.summary: A co-op puzzle game for two tiny worms. Split and reunite your bodies, plan your routes together, and find a way through the garden. Play locally or with Steam Remote Play Together.

releases.name: Stellar Courier
releases.summary: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.

releases.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
releases.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

releases.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
releases.summary: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

releases.name: Zero Sum
releases.summary:
Zero Sum is a pencil-on-paper twin-stick puzzle-roguelite. Your enemies are live integers and your weapons are operators. No health bars. No bullet sponges. Just raw arithmetic violence.

A "48" is charging at you. You fire ÷2. Now it's "24". Three more divisions: "12," "6," "3." Now switch to minus. Bang. Bang. Bang. Zero. Gone. Next.

Build lethal operator synergies across 6 distinct arenas and 3 combat rule sets. Face 9 multi-stage bosses built around weaponized mathematical concepts. Customize your loadout across 7 operators and 22 unlockable firing modes. From rapid-fire setups and execute shots to chain-division, square-root walls, modulo mines, and screen-warping Sigma vortexes.

releases.name: Wild Haven
releases.summary:
Wild Haven is a relaxing nature builder where you bring life back to a ruined world. 

Explore the world around you, clean up the pollution left behind, bring back plants and animals, and grow your woodland forest. 

Unlock your full potential by helping ancient spirits and selecting upgrades to build a vibrant ecosystem.

releases.name: Wisp & Willow
releases.summary:
Use cards to build a garden in this cozy puzzle game. 

Each level has a different deck. Each card has different interactions with other cards. Discover them and decide what kind of garden you want to build for yourself.

releases.name: Pill & Chill
releases.summary:
Somehow, all the pills got mixed together.

Pick up your counting spatula and start sorting. Separate the colors and shapes, sweep matching pills across the table, and guide each one into the right square.

Every pill reacts to the others. They roll, bump, pile up, settle, and occasionally slip away just when you thought you had them. Move them one at a time, or clear a whole group with a careful sweep.

releases.name: Wuxiang Lake
releases.summary:
Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

releases.name: Rusty Robot Wants to Cry
releases.summary:
Retro arcade classics get steamrolled! A rusty robot remixes Arkanoid, Xonix, Digger, Snake, and more into one crazy platformer. 

Every level gives a little rusty robot the same simple job: grab the key and reach the door.

Sounds easy? Well, the rules keep changing.

One moment you're jumping across platforms. The next you're digging, dodging, bouncing, or claiming territory. Familiar arcade mechanics get twisted into something completely new. Even the glitch bosses can't make up their minds - sometimes you fight them, sometimes you need their help!

releases.name: Dawn of Defense
releases.summary:
In this mix of Tower Defense, RTS, and Roguelite progression, you fight for your tribe's survival. The Imperium Aeternum, a massive shadow empire, sends its legions to erase the North and silence its gods.

From the Spiridun, the divine nexus of your forefathers, command your last defense: build towers and rally warriors. Hold the line against endless waves, then strike back to reclaim your lands.

Each battle is a divine trial. As you fall and rise, ancient runestones awaken forgotten powers, reshaping your strategy with every run. Win the gods favor in the dawn of a new age: the Dawn of Defense.

releases.name: Little Noel: Christmas Village
releases.summary: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.

releases.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
releases.summary: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

releases.name: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition
releases.summary: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.

releases.name: Infinipop
releases.summary: A game about popping bubble sheets with your brain switched off. Except every rebirth gives you a new way to pop: drag, multi-pop, full-board shatter, one-hit crush. The faster you clear, the more the screen fills with effects. Ten materials, ten sounds. Twenty board shapes. Endless stages.

releases.name: Angel Investor Simulator
releases.summary: Invest into promising startups. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.
